visualReview.notes: Motif structure agrees in all 18 source/independent pairs at the inspected scale. Circle has specks and faint internal seams; stjerne has faint diagonal traces. Their causes and suitability for clean supervision remain unresolved.

limitations: The 150-degree synthetic turn limit is stricter than the automatic fitter profile; rejections do not establish that published templates are illegal.
Nominal checks assume a 100 mm overlap and do not establish physical assembly performance.
Only five designs were replayed at 512 and 1024; the other initial passes remain 256-resolution evidence.
Raster discrepancies concentrate on boundaries; no exact renderer quantization root cause has been proved.
Distinct stored geometry is not proof of distinct motif or topology families.
Repository templates can overlap evaluation cases. Family grouping and evaluation reservations must precede training allocation.
No source SVG, fitted geometry, production renderer, training manifest or checkpoint was changed.
